children: Czech-based chemicals group Agrofert said on Friday its AGF Nitrogen unit had reduced ammonia production at its plants in Germany, Slovakia, Austria and France to a technological minimum due to continued climb in natural gas prices and high cost of carbon emissions allowances.
A spokesman said the reduction, affecting the production of fertilisers, concerned operations SKW Piesteritz in Germany, Duslo Sala in Slovakia, and LAT Nitrogen's plants in Austria and France.
